description: This file contains functions for handling user interactions and API calls related to WhatsApp login, channel configuration, and Nostr profile management within the OpenClaw application. It manages state updates, API requests, and error handling for profile editing, importing, and saving.

methods.name: parseValidationErrors
methods.description: Parses validation error details from API responses into a key-value object.

methods.name: resolveNostrAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the Nostr account ID from the host's channel snapshot or profile ID.

methods.name: buildNostrProfileUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for Nostr profile API endpoints.

methods.name: resolveGatewayHttpAuthHeader
methods.description: Builds the Authorization header value based on available tokens or passwords.

methods.name: buildGatewayHttpHeaders
methods.description: Creates HTTP headers including authorization for API requests.
